package.name: wheeltec_mycobot_pick_place
package.description:
Voice-triggered apple pick-and-place pipeline for the aggregated WHEELTEC R680 mobile base + myCobot 280 arm.
Pipeline (orchestrated by coordinator_node): 1. voice_command_node - subscribe /asr_command, trigger on "把苹果拿过来" 2. apple_detection_node - YOLOv8 apple detection + 3D pose from depth 3. navigation_node - Nav2 navigate the car close to the apple (dynamic obstacle avoidance) 4. grasp_node - MoveIt2 pick & lift the apple 5. navigation_node - Nav2 to delivery pose (start + offset) 6. grasp_node - place the apple 7. navigation_node - return to start pose
Every node supports a global `sim_mode` parameter: - sim_mode:=true : nodes run on simulated data / fake services - sim_mode:=false : real hardware via wheeltec_mycobot_bringup + speech_controller
